s444ef1f10b6c67: HAMi allows the Bank to recycle different types of accelerators into a single Kubernetes pool. This is particularly critical in the context of China Mercants Bank, where the platform contains a wide variety of heterogeneous community resources, including Kunlen cores, multiple Ascend models, NVIDIA GPU, PPU, Moore Threads, MetaX and other acceleration devices. Without HAMi, each delivery of hardware will normally be accompanied by an independent KuberNetes cluster, which may allow the line to maintain more than eight separate clusters, each with its own set of device plugin, Scheduling strategies, monitoring systems, and movement processes and barrier models.
s73ebbc58ce2e24: With the help of HAMi, these heterogeneous devices can be managed through a single Scheduling framework and consistent platform strategy. The value of HAMi goes beyond equipment slices and controls.
